assertions.name: theta_degeneration_identities_hold
assertions.source: q+q⁻¹=2cosh, q−q⁻¹=2sinh, e^u=cosh+sinh verified to <1e-40; the trigonometric degeneration of θ_even/θ_odd proved in EllipticRTheta.lean.

description: Formalize-first diagnostic for the single-τ elliptic-R/θ hypothesis (QOU/QBeta/EllipticRTheta.lean). Verifies the θ-degeneration identities, computes the figure-eight bar-odd carrier θ(q₀)/Δθ, and scopes WHY the single-τ closure is under-constrained by 2 anchors and what makes it falsifiable (the derived θ-quotient form of the elliptic R uplift, or ≥3 anchors, or the deformed u≠0 construction). No fit; nothing wired; scope-(a).

fig8_carrier.note: Δθ is the parameter-free bar-odd seed (reeb-theta-value.md); the cusp θ=π sits at the CM point q²=e^{iπ/3}, disc −3.

faddeev_lattice_nome_check.verdict_scope_a: REFUTED (scope-a): the c₃ swing is NOT the elliptic correction of the Faddeev uniqueness-ratio period lattice ⟨ib, i/b⟩. Its nome at the substrate is ~1e-42 to ~1e-83 — 40+ orders of magnitude below the 2.4e-2 swing. This is WHY sinh/cosh (the trigonometric degeneration) already works so well: at real q₀ the Faddeev lattice IS at τ→i∞.
faddeev_lattice_nome_check.redirect: If the swing is elliptic at all, the relevant elliptic structure is the GEOMETRIC one — the figure-eight A-polynomial / holonomy curve at the CM point q²=e^{iπ/3} (disc −3, j=0), whose modular parameter is O(1), NOT the Faddeev period lattice. The elliptic-freedom result (PR #4155) is a different (uniqueness) elliptic structure and does not carry the swing.

single_tau_falsifiability.why: A single τ(a) threading BOTH channels is trivially satisfiable through any 2 anchors (2 points lie on a 1-parameter curve), so a 2-anchor fit is NOT a validation and would violate the anti-fit rule. The muon/proton anchors differ by ~11.5 ppb in q₀ yet c₃ swings ~2.43% — the hypersensitivity is real, but it is one degree of freedom, not a curve.
falsifiable_test_requires: the FIXED θ-quotient form of the elliptic (8-vertex) R-matrix uplift of the Hecke R (no free profile f,g) — then θ-value at τ(q₀) is a parameter-free prediction for c₃(q₀);
OR ≥3 independent anchors in q (e.g. q=1 shadow −2, plus two genuinely distinct q₀ points) so the 1-parameter-curve claim can be refuted;

the DEFORMED (u≠0) elliptic construction where the bar-odd part is nonzero (4₁ is amphichiral ⇒ bar-odd=0 at u=0; the swing lives in the deformation, i.e. moving off the CM point along the elliptic curve).
single_tau_falsifiability.verdict: hypothesis STRUCTURALLY MOTIVATED (θ=q-heat-kernel, tier degeneration, elliptic-freedom of the Faddeev ratio) but NOT YET FALSIFIABLE with current data; the derived θ-quotient form is the next formalize-first target, NOT a numerical fit.
